concept: Local LLM server as a coding-agent backend on Mac
summary: Claude Code needs only ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL + a credential (ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN) pointing at a server that speaks /v1/messages. Direct Anthropic-compatible servers on Mac: Ollama (>=0.14), LM Studio (>=0.4.1), oMLX, Rapid-MLX (ex vllm-mlx), llama-server. No LiteLLM shim needed for these.

facts.text: Claude Code needs only ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL + a credential (ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN) pointing at a server that speaks /v1/messages. Direct Anthropic-compatible servers on Mac: Ollama (>=0.14), LM Studio (>=0.4.1), oMLX, Rapid-MLX (ex vllm-mlx), llama-server. No LiteLLM shim needed for these.
Claude Code sends ~20K tokens of system prompt + 30ish tool schemas on turn 1; every later turn resends the same prefix, so correct prefix caching decides usability.

Claude Code prepends a per-request changing attribution line (x-anthropic-billing-header: cc_version=...; cch=...) to the system prompt. That changes the prefix every request and invalidates local KV prefix caches; set CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER=0 (via env block in settings.json, or --settings JSON; older builds ignored the shell export).

Claude Code resolves haiku/sonnet/opus aliases and background calls to Anthropic model names; against a local server that returns 404 mid-session unless ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{HAIKU,SONNET,OPUS}_MODEL (and ANTHROPIC_MODEL) all map to the local model id. settings.json env beats shell exports; /status shows the effective base URL and credential.

Aider does not use native tool calling (edit formats), so tool-parser bugs affect Claude Code/OpenCode/Codex but not Aider; Aider with Ollama must use the ollama_chat/ prefix and sets num_ctx per request.
OpenCode uses an openai-compatible provider (npm @ai-sdk/openai-compatible, baseURL .../v1) with per-model limit.context; the harness-side context cap is the only guard when the server has none.

mlx-lm tool parsing is driven by tokenizer_config.json: a `tool_parser_type` key (e.g. "qwen3_coder") is needed; mlx-community 4-bit Qwen3-Coder ships without it and the client sees raw XML tool-call text. Edit a local copy (hf download --local-dir), not the HF cache (hash change triggers a 17 GB re-download).
2025-12: guides said a translation proxy (LiteLLM / Claude Code Router) was mandatory for Claude Code on local models.
2026-01-16 Ollama 0.14 added Anthropic Messages API; LM Studio 0.4.1 added /v1/messages (Jan 2026). The proxy requirement is obsolete for those runtimes.
2026-03-30 Ollama 0.19 MLX preview (Apple Silicon, needs >32 GB unified memory) with cross-conversation cache reuse and cache checkpoints for shared system prompts.
2026-02/04 mlx-lm server kernel-panic issue (#883) and byte-limited prompt cache PR #906.
2026-09 oMLX has SSD-tiered KV cache; Rapid-MLX 0.15.3 fixed small-RAM agent-session cache.

mlx_lm.server kernel panic: wires ~75% of RAM at start (mx.set_wired_limit), unbounded KV growth in agentic sessions (~58k tokens on 96 GB M3 Ultra with Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B 8-bit), panic string "completeMemory() prepare count underflow" @IOGPUMemory.cpp:550, memoryPressure false because wired memory is not reclaimable by Jetsam. Hard reboot, not a process kill.

Related Metal error: "METAL Command buffer execution failed: Insufficient Memory (kIOGPUCommandBufferCallbackErrorOutOfMemory)" from mlx_lm.server after a few turns, on 48 GB with Qwen3.6-27B 4-bit and MoE 8-bit; --prompt-cache-size 0 / --prompt-cache-bytes 0 only helped slightly.
On an 18 GB M3 Pro, mlx_lm.server 0.31.3 died with Metal OOM on turn 4 of a 23k-token agent session; Ollama, oMLX, Rapid-MLX survived.
oMLX refuses oversized prefill with a guard ("Prefill would require ~9.08 GB peak ... dynamic ceiling is 9.00 GB") on 18 GB for ~16k-token requests.

Workaround for mlx_lm.server: wrapper script calling mx.metal.set_memory_limit(N) (or mx.set_wired_limit) before `from mlx_lm.server import main`; or sudo sysctl iogpu.wired_limit_mb. Default wired cap is ~67% on Macs <=36 GB, ~75% above; setting wired limit to full RAM can panic the machine.
Gemma 4 26B-A4B hybrid attention (50 sliding + 10 global layers) gives >20 GB KV at full context, a poor fit for agent sessions on 64 GB; standard GQA (Qwen3 family) has predictable KV.

Ollama on Mac: default OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE 5m unloads the model, next request waits ~2 min to reload; set 24h for agent use. Ollama pulled GGUF Q4_K_M of qwen3.6:27b with presence_penalty 1.5 in its params (hurt code quality); a Modelfile with presence_penalty 0 fixed it; the -mxfp8 / -nvfp4 / -mlx tags are the Apple-optimised variants.

LM Studio 0.3.21: qwen3-coder-30b emitted <function=...><parameter=...> XML tool calls that OpenCode/Continue/Crush did not recognise (issue #825); a later report says LM Studio's parser silently broke Qwen3.5 tool calls. Qwen3.5 long-task silent tool-call failures were reported fixed on vLLM by a chat-template fix plus --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml instead of qwen3_coder.

Ollama Anthropic compat gaps: no prompt caching (cache_control ignored/unsupported), no tool_choice forcing, URL images unsupported, thinking budget_tokens accepted but not enforced; cloud endpoint needs Authorization: Bearer (x-api-key alone refused); local server ignores keys. Claude Code docs: Anthropic does not support routing Claude Code to non-Claude models through a gateway.
Ollama binds localhost; Docker/LAN clients need OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0:11434.
Having both ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN set triggers an auth-conflict warning; use one. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="" is used in Ollama's own examples.
Cold first turn 63-73 s on every engine (oMLX 63.1, Rapid-MLX 65.1, mlx-lm 65.7, Ollama 73.4); on M3 Pro 18 GB 67-78 s.
Follow-up turns 0.27-0.49 s (Ollama 0.41, mlx-lm 0.47) once the prefix is cached.
After server restart: oMLX 0.27 s (SSD cold tier), Rapid-MLX 12.3 s (disk restore), mlx-lm 65.7 s and Ollama 73.1 s (full re-prefill).
Cold prefill ~16k tokens: 41.7-49.4 s (about 330-390 tok/s on this model); ~2k prompt 5.3-6.4 s.
Decode: Rapid-MLX 66.1, oMLX 51.2, mlx-lm 47.7, Ollama 38.4 tok/s single stream; 4 concurrent: oMLX 97.1, mlx-lm 96.6, Rapid-MLX 68.3, Ollama 37.4 (serial).
30/30 single-call tool prompts on all four engines; multi-step tool use not tested.
Rapid-MLX PFlash (default on for Qwen3.5/3.6) keeps ~20% of prompt tokens: 16k TTFT 8.2 s vs 42.8 s, but the model does not see every token and it does not engage when requests carry tools.
Rapid-MLX 0.15.2 on 18 GB paid full prefill every turn (70 s) because prefix cache sized to 0.86 GB; fixed in 0.15.3. Cache sizing on small-RAM Macs can silently disable reuse.
Rapid-MLX README, M3 Ultra 256 GB B=1: qwen3.8-27b-4bit TTFT 24.7 s, prefill 331 tok/s, decode 43 tok/s (32K).
Unsloth: the attribution header made inference ~90% slower on llama.cpp until disabled.
Ollama 0.19 MLX: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B NVFP4 prefill 1154 -> 1810 tok/s, decode 58 -> 112 tok/s vs 0.18 (Ollama-run, M5-class).
Slow first answer (~1 min) from the ~20K-token system prompt is normal; context under ~25K tokens fails or truncates (LM Studio recommends >=25K; Ollama docs 64k for agents).
Ollama: Ollama API, OpenAI, Anthropic (subset). Cache in-memory per loaded model; reuses prior request cache. Fixed context at load (bounded KV).
LM Studio: OpenAI + Anthropic /v1/messages; GGUF and MLX engines; `lms load --context-length`, `lms server start`, `lms load --estimate-only`; in-memory cache.
mlx_lm.server: OpenAI only, no /v1/messages; tool parser from tokenizer chat template; memory-risky.

oMLX (menu bar app, Apache-2.0): OpenAI + Anthropic; hot RAM + SSD cold KV tier surviving restarts; auto-detected tool formats; one-click config for OpenCode/OpenClaw/Codex; reports model's real context window so Claude Code auto-compact works; SSE keep-alive to avoid read timeouts during long prefill; Metal toolchain needed when building from source.
Rapid-MLX / vllm-mlx: OpenAI, /v1/responses, Anthropic; radix prefix cache; 27 tool-parser modules; `rapid-mlx launch claude-code` patches ~/.claude/settings.json to point at localhost:8000.
llama-server: Anthropic Messages-compatible chat completions, assistant prefill, function calling via Jinja.

LiteLLM shim (LM Studio + Qwen3-Coder-30B): needs alias `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001` mapped to the local model, plus `drop_params: true`, and a clean model alias without slashes. Now only needed for chat-only backends.
Rapid-MLX installer tiers: 8-15 GB lfm2.5-2.6b-4bit; 16-17 GB qwen3.5-4b-4bit; 18-23 GB qwen3.5-9b-4bit; 24-31 GB bonsai-27b-2bit; 32 GB+ qwen3.8-27b-4bit.

LM Studio guide: 16 GB small models only (granite-4-micro for simple edits); gpt-oss-20b ~14 GB needs 16 GB plus context; qwen3-coder-30b (3B active, ~19 GB at 4-bit) best balance at 32 GB; 32K context floor, 64K if memory allows.
48 GB: qwen3.6:35b-a3b-mxfp8 (37 GB, 16K ctx) stable via Ollama + OpenCode; Qwen3.6-27B reported 77.2% SWE-bench Verified.
64 GB: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B 4-bit (~17.5 GB) with native qwen3_coder parser preferred over Gemma 4 26B for agent sessions.
Ollama MLX preview requires >32 GB unified memory; Unsloth says Gemma 4 / Qwen3.5 agentic coding works on 24 GB.
A 20-30B local model is competent for scripts/refactors, not a substitute for frontier models on large multi-file tasks. Keep tasks small and concrete.

Proxy needed vs not: Dec 2025 guide (Hannecke) says Claude Code cannot talk to Ollama/LM Studio without a proxy; Ollama 0.14 and LM Studio 0.4.1 docs (Jan 2026) say native /v1/messages works. Resolved by date; the proxy claim is stale for those runtimes. LiteLLM guide of Mar 2026 (substack) still says Ollama on Apple Silicon lacks MLX, also superseded by Ollama 0.19 MLX preview.

Is mlx_lm.server fixed? PR #906 (Feb 2026) added byte-limited LRUPromptCache and closed #883; Hannecke (Apr 2026, v0.31.2) and Kulman (May 2026, 0.31.3) say --max-kv-size still absent from the server and crashes persist; Rapid-MLX bench (Sep 2026, 0.31.3) shows OOM on 18 GB. Treat as unfixed for agent sessions; no source shows a later fixed release.

Ollama prefix reuse: Rapid-MLX bench shows Ollama reusing cache within session (0.41 s turns), while Ollama's own docs list cache_control (Anthropic prompt caching) as unsupported; these are different mechanisms (server-side KV prefix reuse vs API-level cache blocks).
Vendor bias: speed benchmarks are by the Rapid-MLX authors (disclosed); oMLX's "5 seconds not 90" claim is only half-confirmed (restart case yes, cold turn still ~63 s).
Whether any mlx-lm release after 0.31.3 bounds KV per request in the server.
Multi-step tool-call reliability by model/parser (existing benchmarks are single-call, 8 tools).
Whether LM Studio's MLX engine preserves prompt cache across Claude Code turns (not measured).
Claude Code behaviour with non-Claude models is unsupported by Anthropic; no source on feature degradation (thinking, subagents, count_tokens) beyond Ollama's gap list.
Claude Code works against any server exposing /v1/messages by setting ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN
Ollama has been compatible with the Anthropic Messages API since v0.14.0 (2026-01-16)
Ollama recommended local models for Claude Code at launch were gpt-oss:20b and qwen3-coder
`ollama launch claude --model <m>` configures Claude Code for a local or cloud model; `--yes` requires --model and passes args after -- to Claude Code
Ollama docs say set 64k+ context for larger repositories with Claude Code
Ollama's Anthropic compatibility does not support prompt caching (cache_control), tool_choice forcing, or PDF document blocks
Ollama accepts thinking budget_tokens but does not enforce it; URL images are unsupported
Ollama's cloud /v1/messages requires Authorization: Bearer and rejects x-api-key alone; the local server ignores keys
Ollama 0.19 MLX preview needs a Mac with more than 32 GB unified memory
Ollama 0.19 reuses cache across conversations, stores cache checkpoints in the prompt and evicts shared prefixes last, aimed at Claude Code's shared system prompt
Ollama 0.19 MLX measured prefill 1154 tok/s (0.18) vs 1810 tok/s and decode 58 vs 112 tok/s on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B NVFP4
LM Studio 0.4.1 added an Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages endpoint with streaming and tool use
LM Studio recommends context of at least ~25K tokens for Claude Code
LM Studio accepts x-api-key and Authorization: Bearer when Require Authentication is on
LM Studio's integration page recommends CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER=0
Claude Code background work uses the haiku alias; unmapped, LM Studio returns 404 mid-session, so map ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU/SONNET/OPUS_MODEL to the local model
A settings.json env value overrides a shell export of the same variable
Claude Code's system prompt plus tool definitions is roughly 20K tokens before the first user word
LM Studio's default context is often 4K and Claude Code fails on the first request at that size
`lms load --estimate-only <model> --context-length N` previews memory; `lms ps` shows loaded context
Anthropic does not support routing Claude Code to non-Claude models through any gateway
Claude Code's per-request attribution header at the start of the system prompt invalidates the KV cache and slowed local inference ~90%
Older Claude Code builds ignored the shell CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER; the --settings JSON or settings.json env form is reliable
A LiteLLM proxy config for Claude Code on LM Studio needs the claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 alias mapped to the local model and drop_params: true
mlx_lm.server wires ~75% of RAM at startup via mx.set_wired_limit and had no KV size cap in agentic use
mlx-lm issue #883: kernel panic "completeMemory() prepare count underflow" @IOGPUMemory.cpp:550 at ~58k tokens on M3 Ultra 96 GB with Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B 8-bit under OpenCode
mlx-lm PR #906 added byte-limited LRUPromptCache (max_bytes) to address #883
As of mlx-lm 0.31.2 mlx_lm.server still lacked --max-kv-size, which exists for mlx_lm.generate
mx.metal.set_memory_limit before importing mlx_lm.server turns the panic into a Python exception
mlx-lm tool parsing requires "tool_parser_type" in tokenizer_config.json; mlx-community Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B 4-bit lacks it and OpenCode printed raw XML
Editing tokenizer_config.json in the HF cache triggers a full model re-download; edit a --local-dir copy
Gemma 4 26B-A4B has 50 sliding-window and 10 global layers and >20 GB KV at full context
mlx_lm.server crashed with "METAL Command buffer execution failed: Insufficient Memory" on 48 GB for Qwen3.6-27B 4-bit and MoE 8-bit within a few messages
Ollama unloads models after 5 minutes by default and a reload takes ~2 minutes for a 37 GB model; OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=24h avoids it
ollama pull qwen3.6:27b returned Q4_K_M with presence_penalty 1.5; a Modelfile with presence_penalty 0 fixed quality
qwen3.6:35b-a3b-mxfp8 uses 37 GB at 32K context on 48 GB, 100% GPU, stable under OpenCode via openai-compatible provider
Default Metal wired limit is ~67% of RAM on Macs <=36 GB and ~75% above; `sudo sysctl iogpu.wired_limit_mb=N` changes it and setting it to full RAM can kernel-panic
mlx_lm.server has no context flag, so the harness (OpenCode limit.context) must cap context
mlx-lm README documents --max-kv-size (rotating cache), --prefill-step-size (default 2048, smaller lowers peak memory) and mlx_lm.cache_prompt
Cold prefill of a 22.8k-token Claude-Code-shaped request took 63-73 s on M4 Pro 48 GB across Ollama, mlx-lm, oMLX, Rapid-MLX
Follow-up turns took 0.27-0.49 s once the prefix was cached on all four engines
After a server restart only oMLX (SSD tier, 0.27 s) and Rapid-MLX (disk restore, 12.3 s) avoided a full re-prefill; Ollama and mlx-lm needed 73 s and 66 s
mlx_lm.server 0.31.3 died with Metal OOM on turn 4 of the agent session on an 18 GB M3 Pro
oMLX refused a ~16k-token prefill on 18 GB with a memory guard error
All four engines passed 30/30 single-call tool prompts with Qwen3.5-9B; multi-step tool use was not tested
Rapid-MLX PFlash prefill compression keeps ~20% of tokens, cuts 16k TTFT from 42.8 s to 8.2 s, and does not engage on requests carrying tools
Rapid-MLX 0.15.2 re-prefilled every turn on 18 GB because its prefix cache sized to 0.86 GB; 0.15.3 fixed it
Single-stream decode on M4 Pro 48 GB, Qwen3.5-9B 4-bit: Rapid-MLX 66.1, oMLX 51.2, mlx-lm 47.7, Ollama 38.4 tok/s
Rapid-MLX serves OpenAI, /v1/responses and Anthropic /v1/messages and `rapid-mlx launch claude-code` patches ~/.claude/settings.json
mlx_lm.server does not expose /v1/messages; Ollama (v0.14) and LM Studio (0.4.1) do
oMLX keeps hot (RAM) and cold (SSD) KV tiers with prefix sharing and survives restarts
oMLX reports the model's real context window to Claude Code auto-compact and sends SSE keep-alives during long prefill
oMLX serves /v1/messages and auto-detects tool-call formats per model family
oMLX building from source needs the Metal toolchain (full Xcode), else "xcrun: error: unable to find utility metal"
LM Studio qwen3-coder-30b emitted <function=...><parameter=...> XML tool calls that OpenCode, Continue and Crush did not recognise (LM Studio 0.3.21)
A Qwen3.5 long-task tool-call failure was reported fixed by a chat-template change plus --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml instead of qwen3_coder
Aider recommends the ollama_chat/ prefix and sets Ollama num_ctx to request size plus 8k unless a model settings file fixes num_ctx
Aider's Ollama page still states Ollama defaults to a 2k context window
Ollama binds localhost by default; Docker clients need OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0:11434
Claude Code Router can route default, think and background requests to different local models (30B for main, 8B for background)
Rapid-MLX's installer RAM tiers: 8-15 GB lfm2.5-2.6b, 16-17 GB qwen3.5-4b, 18-23 GB qwen3.5-9b, 24-31 GB bonsai-27b-2bit, 32 GB+ qwen3.8-27b-4bit
On M3 Ultra 256 GB qwen3.8-27b-4bit measured TTFT 24.66 s, prefill 331 tok/s, decode 43.4 tok/s through 32K
qwen3-coder-30b (3B active, ~19 GB at 4-bit) is the best balance for agentic work at 32 GB; gpt-oss-20b needs 16 GB plus context
Unsloth reports Gemma 4 and Qwen3.5 agentic coding works on 24 GB unified memory devices
A model with no working tool calling explains edits but never touches files
Both ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN set yields an auth-conflict startup warning
Anthropic-format local servers make LiteLLM unnecessary except for chat-only backends
Unbounded-KV servers on Macs fail by kernel panic because wired memory evades Jetsam, while fixed-context servers fail by OOM error or truncation

Ollama default context: Aider docs still say Ollama defaults to 2k; Ollama FAQ/ existing playbook say 4k/32k/256k by VRAM; Kulman saw 32768 on 48 GB.
